body:
Merged the new base and main to resolve the conflicts. No rebase and no force-push. The PR stays a draft.

## What the merges brought

1. `a3a499ad6`: the updated parent branch `issue/1648-wcs-page-work-offset` (#1717, head `82fd8d768`). The parent rework changed `wcs_page.rs` from CRLF to LF line endings.
2. `976f4d6bf`: `origin/main` at `d1484f02a`. This includes #1859 (setup-change retract), #1866 (decimal points in Fanuc-family posts) and the WCS part-point picks (`wcs_part_point_tests`).

## Files resolved by hand

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs`: the conflict covered the whole file because this branch stored the file with CRLF line endings. The two sides have LF. I did a three-way merge of the normalized text. The result keeps the `FLIPS` toggles, `flip_row` and the flip note of this PR. It also keeps the pick text of main and `pick_button::pick_widget` of main. The file now has LF line endings, as on main.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs`: both sides added a test module at the same line. I kept both: `wcs_flip_tests` and `wcs_part_point_tests`.

All other files merged without a conflict. The diff against main lists only the files of #1717 and of this PR (35 files). The post refusal in `posting.rs` and the generation refusal in `collect_job` are additions only. All refusals of main stay. The project file version is 62 here and 61 on main, so there is no clash.

## Tests on head `976f4d6bf`

- `camcraft-app --test wcs_flip`: 10 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test program_info` (it pins the project version >= 61): 10 passed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 820 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. This includes `wcs_flip_tests`, `wcs_part_point_tests`, `wcs_page_tests`, `one_wcs`, `structural` and `setup_settings_page`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Class

DELTA. The conflict in `wcs_page.rs` was resolved by hand. A delta review of the remerge-diff is necessary.

## Open items (not changed by this refresh)

- This PR is still stacked on #1717. Its base is `issue/1648-wcs-page-work-offset`. Retarget it to `main` before #1717 merges.
- #1717 has `needs-rework`: it needs before and after screenshots in its body.
- This PR also has no before and after screenshots (UI change).

Ready for a re-check.
The parent PR #1717 merged, and the base of this PR is now `main`. This PR needs `git merge origin/main` and a new gate before review.

Merged `origin/main` at `3f41b8da6` into the branch. The new head is `ffc673589`. No rebase and no force-push. The PR stays a draft.

## Files resolved by hand

- `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, `apply.rs`, `mod.rs`: main used v62 to v66 for other keys (#1453, #1557, #2015, #2133, #1962). This branch used v62 for the WCS `flip` key. I kept all version notes of main without change. The `flip` key is now v67, and `PROJECT_VERSION` is 67. No version number has two meanings. I also changed the v62 text to v67 in `entity.rs`, in the `apply.rs` flip read, and in `docs/decisions/1720-wcs-flip-flags.md`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_page.rs`: both sides added a constant at the same line. I kept the two: `FLIPS` (this PR) and `MILL_TILT_HINT` (main). The other parts of the file merged without a conflict. The file has LF line endings and no CR bytes.
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`: I kept the new `set_wcs_from_features` row of main and added the `set_wcs_flip` row of this PR.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`: this file is now the same as on `origin/main`. The PR still changes a process file (`SKILL.md`), so the body keeps `Process change: yes`.

## Safety checks

- The post refusal in `verification_report_by` and the generation refusal in `collect_job` are additions only. All refusals of main stay.
- All post paths of main use `verification_report_by` (`post_script_body_with`, `posting_mounts`, `posting_per_op`).
- The WCS word in the refusal comes from `setup::wcs_name`. The PR adds no second G54-G59 derivation.
- `git diff origin/main --stat` lists only the 29 files of this PR.

## Gate on `ffc673589`

- `camcraft-app`, 29 binaries, all pass: `wcs_flip` 10, `program_info` 10, `project_roundtrip` 73, `trunnion_schema` 2, `tilt_basis_compat` 5, `break_through` 7, `tap_hand` 7, `units_migrate` 5, `one_wcs` 8, `setup_wcs` 7, `setup_relative` 9, `wcs_tilt` 2, `wcs_index` 4, `wcs_align` 5, `wcs_roles` 9, `rotated_wcs` 9, `mcp_setup` 9, `mcp_work_offset` 4, `mcp_wcs_features` 2, `mcp_verify` 3, `post_not_judged` 4, `carried_verify` 8, `setup_mounts_post` 8, `setup_mount` 6, `rotary_verify` 9, `stock_source_verdict` 22, `index_swing` 13, `wire_verify` 3, `probe_only_sim` 2.
- `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 1004 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The full quick-gate selection (394 steps) did not run.

## Class

DELTA. Conflicts were resolved by hand, and the project version changed from 62 to 67. A delta review of the remerge-diff is necessary.

GitHub now shows the PR as `MERGEABLE`. I removed the `conflicts` label.

Ready for a re-check.
